scope: Atomic candidates for N2. All operands are normal binary32 words or zero. The allowed primitive returns a finite normal binary32 word or a certified exact zero. These cases are not material/device/physical acceptance.

cases.must_bind: The positive product is included exactly once. A materialized FP32 g*g is out of range.
Any common square rescaling requires k>=37 for the product and k<=0 for D*2^(2k) to be finite. A single fused operation can return D.
Physical coordinate order is retained; any evaluation permutation and zero addends appear in the receipt.
Second product is nonzero and has negative sign in the aggregate.
Two separately rounded operations would give zero.

cases.expected: canonical zero for an exact determinant claim
cases.must_bind: One rounded anchor followed by FMA can instead yield magnitude 2^-46. A finite correctly executed FMA alone does not prove the full determinant's sign.
Ties-to-even picks the minimum normal over the odd maximum subnormal; evaluate the actual RN cell.

cases.expected: reject if this product is a required normal-or-zero published field
cases.must_bind: A normal final displacement of 1 from a fused update cannot substitute for a valid raw product.
Nearest-even rounds to zero but the exact source is nonzero.
Overflow must not publish an infinity, saturation or repaired finite value.

gates: Fixed arithmetic only. Preserve the original v2 rejection, F0/Feff, R/d, raw-products binding, range, error and iteration policy. No probe, code execution, physical grant or timing claim.
